_readme: Editable content for the WEVE landing page (BR-13): site links, the areas and points of interest shown in the text-only tour, and the 3D room tour (rooms). Info images are optional and live in client/public/images/info/; missing ones are hidden automatically.

campus.name: Western Engineering campus
campus.description: A 3D model of the engineering precinct: the building masses sit on satellite imagery of the site. A sign at the entrance of the Amit Chakma Engineering Building (ACEB) opens room ACEB 1420.

aceb-1420.name: ACEB 1420
aceb-1420.description: A lecture hall captured with a LiDAR scan. Curved, tiered rows of desks face a front wall of whiteboards, a curved desk stands at the front, and a projector hangs from the ceiling.

infoPoints.title: Whiteboards
infoPoints.text: Whiteboards run along the front wall of ACEB 1420. During lectures, Lecturers would write Mathamatical proofs, Formulas, or worked examples
infoPoints.imageAlt: The whiteboards on the front wall

infoPoints.title: Front desk
infoPoints.text: A curved desk sits at the front of the room, inside the innermost row. This desk is often used by the lecturer to connect their device to prepare for lecture
infoPoints.imageAlt: The curved desk at the front of the room

infoPoints.title: Tiered seating
infoPoints.text: Curved, tiered rows of desks face the front of the room, so every seat looks down at the whiteboards. This room has a seating capacity of 400.
infoPoints.imageAlt: Curved rows of desks rising toward the back

infoPoints.title: Projector
infoPoints.text: A projector hangs from the ceiling in the middle of the room. Placeholder: link the team's projector video here once it is approved.

infoPoints.title: Doors
infoPoints.text: Doors open into the room at both ends. This lead to the ACEB hallway
